subject: suppressWarnings(..., classes = "warning") call in inla.R error for R 3.6

messages.author: 6b3dfa6c2646a8c1
messages.subject: suppressWarnings(..., classes = "warning") call in inla.R error for R 3.6
parts:
Dear ‪Håvard,

I believe that the addition of the call to suppressWarnings(..., classes = "warning") on line 2362 of inla.R the testing release may create an error for using the 'testing' branch in R 3.6 because the `classes` argument was added in R 4.0.

Here is the commit and line referenced: https://github.com/hrue/r-inla/commit/0e9a9db3d57608946bc0e26f2cbc3c58302df907#diff-5acd5cdf6ed0f334fc512d9230ec9000R2362

Since `classes = "warning"` is the default argument value for suppressWarnings(...) in R 4.0, would it be feasible to drop the explicit inclusion of the argument there for backward compatibility with R 3.6?

Thanks,
Jeff

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] suppressWarnings(..., classes = "warning") call in inla.R error for R 3.6
parts:
This is a good idea. I’ll do that and it will appear in the next build. 

Thx.
H
